resources.string: Place phone flat on your chest over sternum (screen up). Lie still and relax.
Place phone FACE DOWN on chest (screen against chest, camera up). Rest index finger on camera flash.
Camera and flash access is needed for photoplethysmography (PPG) pulse transit sensing.
First, place your phone flat on a table and tap \'Zero Surface\'. This measures sensor noise and ensures 0 BPM when not on your body.
Place phone flat on your bare chest or light shirt, screen facing up over your lower sternum. You can watch the real-time cardiac waveforms!
Place phone FACE DOWN on your chest so the camera and flash face UP. Rest your index finger gently on the camera without lifting the phone.
Press the Volume-Down key to start the 15-second guided measurement hands-free while lying down!
